final: WITH ref_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, CAST(execution_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions) AS share FROM ref_counts), scored AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM shares) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average FROM scored ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
